Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly requested corroboration using authoritative sources (e.g., opening and verifying Wikipedia/IMDb pages), WebSurfer continued relying on DuckDuckGo snippets without opening or validating the underlying pages. This led to redundant, circular queries and lack of proper source verification, failing to build systematically on prior results.
